text.en:
This Order shall take effect as of January 1, 1951,
the date Municipal Ordinance No. 3420 of the City of
Manila took effect.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of April, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-one, and of the
Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
1631
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
